I’m a UI/UX Designer focused on creating thoughtful, highimpact digital experiences that go beyond visuals. My approach

designing solutions that are both intuitive and scalable. I’ve worked

bridge the gap between design and implementation. Aiming to build
products that are not only well-designed, but also technically sound.
